businesses.business: life safety, security and specialty building services

offering_description.value: Provides inspection, testing, maintenance, repair and installation of fire protection, life safety, security, HVAC and elevator systems, plus specialty infrastructure services. Customers are commercial, industrial and public-sector building owners and operators. Delivered through a network of branches with field technicians and contract crews.

primary_products.value: fire sprinkler systems; fire alarm and suppression systems; security systems; HVAC equipment installations; elevator equipment

primary_services.value: fire protection inspection and monitoring; system maintenance and repair; HVAC and mechanical services; elevator maintenance and modernization; specialty infrastructure and utility services

customer_segment.value: B2B: commercial and industrial building owners, property managers, general contractors, utilities; B2G: government, schools, military and public infrastructure facilities

end_markets.value: commercial real estate; healthcare; education; industrial and manufacturing; data centers; utilities and infrastructure

revenue_model.value: service fees: recurring inspection, testing, monitoring and maintenance contracts and repair work; project or contract: new installation and construction projects for buildings and infrastructure

value_chain_position.value: service provider: buys equipment and materials and delivers inspection, maintenance and repair services to building owners; other: installation contractor for fire protection, HVAC and security systems on construction projects

geography_served.value: global: North America (US and Canada), Europe, Australia, Asia and other international markets

specialization.value: related lines: safety services (fire, security, entry), specialty services (elevator, HVAC, infrastructure) for buildings

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: branch-based sales teams selling to building owners, contractors and facility managers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: fire and life safety codes (NFPA), local licensing, OSHA safety and elevator regulations
